passages.livelihood: Fishing provides the family's liv_______, the means by which they earn enough to live.
passages.magnetism: The demonstration illustrates mag______ by showing the attraction between a magnet and certain metal objects.
passages.marginally: The second result was mar_______ higher, differing by only a very small amount.
passages.matriarch: The family regards its oldest woman as the mat______, its respected female head.
passages.memorable: The unusual performance was mem______ and remained in the audience's minds long afterward.
passages.neurotransmitter: The lesson describes a neu_____________ as a chemical messenger involved in communication between nerve cells.
passages.obligation: The contract creates an obl_______, a duty the parties are required to fulfill.
passages.paradox: The argument presents a par____, an apparently contradictory statement that invites closer examination.
passages.percent: Twenty-five per____ of the items means twenty-five out of every hundred.
passages.pest: The farmer described the crop-damaging insect as a pe__.
passages.physical: The athlete underwent a phy_____ assessment focused on the condition of the body.
passages.potent: The substance is pot___, producing a strong effect even in a small amount.
passages.prehistoric: The museum displays tools from a pre________ period before written records were kept.

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete liv_______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：elihood → livelihood。学習語：livelihood。「生計・生活の手段」。暮らしを支える収入源です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete mag______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：netism → magnetism。学習語：magnetism。「磁気」。磁石が特定の金属を引きつける作用を例にしています。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete mar_______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ginally → marginally。学習語：marginally。「わずかに」。二つの値の差が小さいことです。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete mat______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：riarch → matriarch。学習語：matriarch。「女性の家長・女性の長」。家族を代表する尊敬された女性です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete mem______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：orable → memorable。学習語：memorable。「記憶に残る」。長く覚えているほど印象の強い演技です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete neu_____________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：rotransmitter → neurotransmitter。学習語：neurotransmitter。「神経伝達物質」。神経細胞間の信号伝達に関わる化学物質です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete obl_______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：igation → obligation。学習語：obligation。「義務」。契約によって果たすことが求められる責務です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete par____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：adox → paradox。学習語：paradox。「逆説・矛盾」。一見矛盾していても、詳しく考える必要のある言明です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete per____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：cent → percent。学習語：percent。「パーセント・百分率の」。百個当たり二十五個という割合を表します。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete pe__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：st → pest。学習語：pest。「害虫・害を及ぼす生物」。この文では作物を傷める昆虫を指します。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete phy_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：sical → physical。学習語：physical。「身体の・物理的な」。この文では体の状態に関わる評価です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete pot___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ent → potent。学習語：potent。「強力な・効力のある」。少量でも強い作用があるという描写です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete pre________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：historic → prehistoric。学習語：prehistoric。「先史時代の」。文字による記録が残る前の時代です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete pro_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：lific → prolific。学習語：prolific。「多作の・豊富な・多産の」。この文では非常に多くの本を書く作家を修飾します。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 20 · Words 31–45: complete pro____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：voke → provoke。学習語：provoke。「引き起こす・刺激する・挑発する」。発言が怒りの反応を誘うことです。
